scope: Two published classifier specialist lessons compared with their current GUI consumers

lessons.disposition: Targeted narration and UI verification required, not regeneration merely for moving the route
findings: Scene 2 permits a registry as input, but the current GUI accepts a directory and rejects non-directories before scanning
Scene 4 promises smoothing and selectable settings fields; the current screen offers Metric, Folds and Overlay selected, with an automatic settings diff
Scene 6 should distinguish the best and last epochs of an observed metric curve from loading or independently evaluating best/final checkpoint artifacts
lessons.supported_workflow: Discover run directories, list incomplete runs and warnings, select candidates, overlay per-fold/mean-SD curves, inspect automatically grouped settings differences

lessons.disposition: Refresh the distinction between computing evaluation outputs and inspecting existing bundles
findings: The current screen discovers and loads existing evaluation bundles; it does not provide the narrated general form for class order, calibration bins, grouping, bootstrap settings and leakage-check configuration
The visible confidence threshold belongs to inspection of confusion-matrix errors, not a general evaluation-run configuration
Current interactions include Summary, Confusion matrix, Per-plate metrics, Calibration, Predictions filtering and Leakage audit; confusion cells expose linked crop inspection
Loading reports must not be narrated as freshly producing discrimination/calibration/leakage/robustness analyses
lessons.scientific_caution: High-confidence disagreement is not by itself proof of a wrong annotation; inspect provenance, images and possible model errors. Existing Classify tutorial artifacts have a separately recorded split-identity limitation and are not certified held-out biological validation.

other_classifier_lessons: 10, 11 and 16 were read but not certified unchanged by this bounded audit; their full consumer and data acceptance remain separate
publication: Held; this record neither changes live lesson text nor approves historical media
